verdict.rationale: There are references to installing via Homebrew (runanywhere-comm-4, comm-9) and docs implying a one-command, zero-config setup (runanywhere-docs-7), but hands-on community reports directly contradict a smooth package-manager install: a segmentation fault after install (runanywhere-comm-3), broken functionality when 'installed via homebrew' (runanywhere-comm-4), and an install script that silently installs Homebrew itself rather than using it cleanly (runanywhere-comm-9), plus generic 'doesn't work' reports (runanywhere-comm-14). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a standard package-manager command (e.g., `brew install runanywhere`), and independent confirmation that install succeeds reliably without workarounds.
